meta.lore_check: rules/core_rules.txt: active magic is female-only (Veil Sorceress line, human/elf women); men never activate magic; passive magic via items, potions, runes and relics is allowed for everyone. rules/magic_rules.json: corruption stages, purge methods (breath_ritual, saint_relic). No surgery/medicine skill exists in the repo.

surgery.fallback_note: No surgery skill in the repo: uses skills['surgery'] if present, else (INT + DEX) / 2.

infection.note: Infection damage is spread with floor 1: it cannot kill on its own (fair rule).

surgery.severed: Mundane surgery cannot reattach a severed part: only stabilise (stops that zone's bleeding) or fit a prosthesis.

severed_regrowth.note: Rare and costly: Veil flesh regrows, never quite right (counts toward corruption marks).

relic_or_potion.severed: only a saint relic (rules/magic_rules.json saint_relic, 1 charge) can restore a severed part, no corruption
